title.zh: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
title.en: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom

current_state.zh: Anthropic's S-1 filing ahead of its IPO discloses that data center expansion is increasingly dependent on natural gas and constrained by intense competition for electricity supply and powered sites, surfacing AI's energy and climate risk to public-market investors.
